neighbours.label: the copula right before an expected 'already' in a duplicate-entry message ('Sorry, that username is | already taken'); the output promotes 'already' in many languages
fire: Sorry, that email address is already registered with us.
Sorry, that nickname is already in use by another player.
Sorry, this seat is already reserved for someone else.
Sorry, that domain name is already owned by another customer.
Cannot add contact: this phone number is already in your contacts.
Sorry, that coupon code is already redeemed.
Upload failed: a document with this title is already stored in the library.
Sorry, this table is already booked for tonight.
quiet: Sorry, we could not find an account with those details.
Sorry, your nickname must be at least four letters long.
Sorry, please choose a seat before you continue.
Sorry, we cannot process domain orders on weekends.
Cannot add contact: please enter a phone number first.
Sorry, coupon codes cannot be combined with other offers.
Upload failed: please check your connection and try again.
Sorry, we do not take bookings by email.

notes: Card: peaks on is/are/ist before 'already' ('"%s" is already in your address book', 'Those channels are already linked'); logit effect promotes déjà/уже/già/bereits/Already. Probes: 'Sorry, that username is' 0.36 whatever follows, 'this email address is already on the list' 0.27, narrative 'had already started' 0.14, messages with no duplicate reading ~0. Weak in probes, so the median may fall short.
